displayName: Gameday report FELL BACK to rule-based

documentation.content: The agent failed and the user got the rule-based report. The job still exits 0, so this is the ONLY alert that sees it. Look at the `agent failed:` line just above in the gameday-report logs. Happened once before alerts existed (10/9, Gemini 429).
